recipe.text: On behalf of all the outcasts, on behalf of all those who have been called monsters... I will show them the REAL MONSTER!
recipe.label: Boğuk ork reisi · tehditkâr

phonemes: ˌɒn bɪhˈɑːf ɒv ˈɔːl ðɪ ˈaʊtkasts, ˌɒn bɪhˈɑːf ɒv ˈɔːl ðəʊz hˌuː hɐvbɪn kˈɔːld mˈɒnstəz... aɪ wɪl ʃˈəʊ ðˌɛm ðə ɹˈiəl mˈɒnstə!
